message.content: All figures reconcile with the filing. Placing one buy order: 44 shares at a $222.90 limit (44 × $222.90 = $9,807.60, under the $10,000 per-order cap; 45 shares would exceed it).
message.reasoning:
All figures confirmed. Now decide.

Fundamentals: FY2024 revenue $391.0B (+2%), operating income $123.2B, net income $93.7B (down 3.4% due to one-time $10.2B Irish tax charge), diluted EPS $6.08, OCF $118.3B. Gross margin 46.2% (up from 44.1%), Services +13% to $96.2B at 73.9% margin. Greater China -8%. Strong balance sheet, $140.8B cash+securities, $95B buybacks.

News: shares little changed ~$222, iPhone 16 supplier builds steady into December, analysts keeping holiday estimates unchanged. Neutral-to-mildly-positive.

Quote: $222.70 last, bid 222.68/ask 222.72. Feed showed ~$220.5 at 9:57 but quote as_of 15:05 shows 222.70. Use current quote.

Decision: Buy. Mandate: max $10,000 per order, $20,000 total today, buy only, limit near market. Cash $50,000 available.

Quantity: at ~$222.70, 44 shares = $9,798.80. 45 shares = $10,021.50 > $10,000. So 44 shares.

Limit price: close to market. Use $222.90 (slightly above ask to ensure fill, ~0.09% above last). That's close to market. Max cost 44 × 222.90 = $9,807.60 < $10,000. Good.

Place order.

Key figures: revenue 391035 USD millions FY2024, net_income 93736, eps_diluted 6.08, operating_income 123216, operating_cash_flow 118254.
